album.description: Album name if this music belongs to a released album
album.title: Album

author.description: Post author snapshot (id, username, displayName, verified, followerCount, avatarUrl)
author.title: Author

authorName.description: Display name of the music author/creator
authorName.title: Author Name

collectCount.description: Number of times post was saved/collected
collectCount.title: Collect Count

coverLarge.description: Large cover image URL for the music
coverLarge.title: Cover Large

createTime.description: Unix timestamp when the post was created
createTime.title: Create Time

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of post creation
createdAt.title: Created At

dspLinks.description: Links to streaming platforms (Spotify, Apple Music, etc.) if available
dspLinks.title: DSP Links

duetEnabled.description: Whether duets are allowed on this post
duetEnabled.title: Duet Enabled

duration.description: Duration of the music in seconds
duration.title: Duration

isAd.description: Whether the post is a paid advertisement
isAd.title: Is Ad

isCommerceMusic.description: Whether this is a commercial music track
isCommerceMusic.title: Is Commerce Music

isCopyrighted.description: Whether the music is under copyright
isCopyrighted.title: Is Copyrighted

isOriginal.description: Whether this is an original sound created by a user
isOriginal.title: Is Original Sound

isUnlimitedMusic.description: Whether this is an unlimited-use music track
isUnlimitedMusic.title: Is Unlimited Music

locationCreated.description: Country code where the post was created
locationCreated.title: Location Created

matchedMusicId.description: The music/sound ID that this post was found under (post rows only)
matchedMusicId.title: Matched Music ID

mediaUrlExpiresAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when signed media URLs expire
mediaUrlExpiresAt.title: Media URL Expires At

music.description: The sound/music used in this post (post rows only). Contains id, title, authorName, duration, playUrl, coverUrl.
music.title: Music

musicTitle.description: Title of the music or sound
musicTitle.title: Music Title

musicUrl.description: Canonical TikTok URL for this sound
musicUrl.title: Music URL

playUrl.description: Signed CDN URL to stream the music audio (expires)
playUrl.title: Play URL

postUrl.description: Direct URL to the TikTok post
postUrl.title: Post URL

rowType.description: Discriminator: 'music' for music metadata rows; absent for post rows
rowType.title: Row Type

shareEnabled.description: Whether sharing is enabled on this post
shareEnabled.title: Share Enabled

shareMeta.description: Share title and description for this music
shareMeta.title: Share Meta

stitchEnabled.description: Whether stitching is allowed on this post
stitchEnabled.title: Stitch Enabled

textLanguage.description: Language code of the caption text
textLanguage.title: Text Language

video.description: Video metadata (width, height, duration, ratio, playUrl, cover, etc.)
video.title: Video
